analysis.title: JPM Daily Credit Strategy Update: Resilient HG inflows; reinvestment income falls by half next week
key_insights: IG cash spreads widened 2.2bp on Thursday 11/5 to 105bp, the YTD wides and the same level as the close on the Tuesday before the election. The Nasdaq is down 4.86% since then, so credit outperformed equities.
IG CDX widened only 3.5bp on Thursday against 6bp implied by a 5-year regression on the NDX (R² 0.59). IG CDX includes all the hyperscalers since the last roll.
Hyperscaler cash bonds widened 2.6bp versus 2.1bp for JULI ex-hyperscalers. TRACE showed a second straight day of net dealer buying (-$1.3bn).

HG fund flows rose to $6.6bn for the week (+50% WoW), against a 4-week average of $3.6bn. The week includes the first day of the month, which usually brings a surge in inflows. Mutual funds flipped to $1.2bn of inflows (highest in 9 weeks), while ETF inflows fell to $5.4bn (-28% WoW).
JPM's estimate of flows into HG corporate bonds across the fund complex was $4.1bn (+26% WoW). Corp-only funds took in $3.3bn, led by $2.5bn into the intermediate bucket (highest in 18 weeks).

HY fund inflows were $1.8bn (highest in 13 weeks) and leveraged loans flipped to $816mn of inflows. Muni inflows fell to $1.6bn (-38% WoW). Money market funds took in $130.2bn (6th highest weekly inflow on record, highest since September 2024) and equity funds $34bn (doubled).

Gross HG issuance this week was $73bn against $29bn of reinvestment income ($20bn maturities, $9bn coupons). JPM estimates reinvestment income falls to $14bn next week ($9bn maturities, $5bn coupons), 51% below both the November weekly average and the 2026 weekly average.
JPM's estimate of HG dealer inventories (>13m) is at its highest since July 2024, at the 100th percentile of the 3-month range. HY dealer inventories are at 62% of their 3-month range.
The BBB-A non-financial spread difference is 42bp, the widest since May 2025, and JPM's relative value screen flags BBB as wide to A.
JULI hyperscaler spreads are at 166bp (97th percentile of the 3-month range) while JULI ex-hyperscalers are at 100bp (100th percentile).

CDX HY sold off 75c / 16bp on Thursday to $105.8 / 357bp. CDX HY underperformed its underlying CDS by 8bp and trades 7bp rich to fair value. CDX IG 5y widened 3.4bp to 62.4bp and trades 2bp rich to fair value.
3-month implied vol is 48% for CDX IG and 46% for CDX HY, both at the top of their 3-month ranges, while iTraxx Main (44%) and Crossover (45%) are low in their ranges.
Credit curves are flat: 3s5s at 16bp, 5s10s at 23bp, 10s30s at 16bp, all in the bottom half of their 1-month ranges.
risk_factors: Spreads are at the YTD wides of 105bp after the equity selloff, and the Nasdaq is down 4.86% since the election.
Dealer inventories of HG bonds are at the highest since July 2024 and at the 100th percentile of the 3m range, which limits balance sheet capacity to absorb supply.
Hyperscaler spreads are at 166bp, the 97th percentile of the 3m range, and widen faster than the rest of the index in selloffs.
Money market inflows of $130.2bn are the sixth highest on record, so flows are moving to cash.
HG fund inflows were boosted by the first day of the month, so the headline $6.6bn overstates the underlying pace.
CDX HY widened 16bp on the day and is rich to fair value by 7bp.
charts_described: Figure 1 plots the daily change in IG CDX (bp) against the NDX % change, with R² of 0.59, showing the +3.5bp actual move on 11/5 against +6bp implied by the 5yr lookback.
vol_and_positioning: CDX IG 3m implied vol is 48% (+8 pts on the day), at the 100th percentile of its 1m and 3m ranges. CDX HY 3m implied vol is 46% (+6 pts), also at 100%.
iTraxx Main 3m implied vol is 44% and Crossover 45%, in the 20% and 19% of their 1m ranges. 3m implied-to-realized vol is 1.36x for Main and 1.38x for Crossover.
CDX IG 25-75 delta skew is 23% and CDX HY 18%. CDX IG and HY 1m3m term skew is inverted at -1.9% and -1.6%, at the 0th percentile of the 1m and 3m ranges.
HG net dealer positions >13m are $6.9bn, up $8.1bn on the week, at the 100th percentile of the 3m range. Positions are at the 95th percentile in 1-5yr, 100th in 5-10yr and 81st in 10+yr.
HG fund flows were $6.6bn on the week, but Thursday's HG mutual fund and ETF flows were only $88mn, 91% below the 5-day average.
HG TRACE volume was $47.1bn Thursday against a YTD average of $44.7bn/day. Dealers net bought $11.8bn over 5 days and $20.8bn over 10 days.
The cash-vs-equity relationship shows US HY vs Russell 2000 and US HG vs S&P 500 at the 100th percentile of their 3m ranges.

tension_points.bull_case: Credit outperformed equities: IG cash spreads are flat versus the pre-election close while the Nasdaq is down 4.86%, and IG CDX widened 3.5bp against 6bp implied by its equity beta. Dealers were net buyers for a second day and HG fund inflows were $6.6bn.
tension_points.bear_case: Spreads are at the YTD wides of 105bp, dealer inventories are at their highest since July 2024, CDX IG and HY implied vols are at the top of their ranges, and hyperscaler spreads are at the 97th percentile of their range.

theme_stances.key_argument: Credit outperformed equities in the selloff, with IG CDX widening less than its equity beta implies.
